201.description: Shift plan committed. `Location` identifies the committed plan's canonical resource path (no dedicated GET for a standalone plan today — `plannedThroughput` and the committed split are also visible indirectly via `GET /paths/{pathId}/rebalance`'s labor context).

Location.description: Canonical URI of the committed shift plan.

travelDistanceM.description: The real travel distance, in metres, between fromLocationCode and toLocationCode as reported by facility-layout at commit time (ADR-0017). Omitted entirely — not defaulted to 0 — when no travel-distance hint was recorded: either the request did not supply both location codes, or the lookup was unavailable/unknown/refused (e.g. the two locations sit in different zones).

travelDistanceEstimated.description: True when the recorded travel distance used a zone's bay pitch fallback rather than real aisle centreline geometry (mirrors facility-layout's own TravelDistance.estimated field). Omitted together with travelDistanceM when no hint was recorded.

400.description: Malformed body, a missing required field (`plannedHeads`, `installedStations`, `rateUnitsPerHour`, `hours` — zero-valued defaults are never silently accepted), an invalid field value (e.g. non-positive rate or hours), the `plannedHeads <= installedStations` invariant was violated, or the computed `plannedThroughput` (rate × heads × hours) is not representable as a finite number.

schema.description: RFC 7807 (https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc7807) Problem Details for HTTP APIs. Every error response in this service uses this shape with Content-Type application/problem+json.

type.description: A URI identifying the error category (does not need to resolve to a real page). Stable per distinct error category in this service.

status.description: Duplicates the HTTP status code (RFC 7807 requirement).

detail.description: The specific error message for this occurrence.

instance.description: The request path that produced the error, omitted if there is no natural resource path.

schema.title: Problem

500.description: An unexpected server-side failure (e.g. a repository or event-publisher error).
